name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport security began with a childhood fascination for racing, fueled by watching British Touring Car Championship races with his father. After earning a degree in Security Management, he sought an opportunity to combine his passion with his professional skills. He started as a junior security officer at a local racing circuit before transitioning into motorsport career management.

Alistair is highly organized and meticulous, ensuring no detail is overlooked in his quest to provide a secure environment. His approach is centered around preventative measures, risk assessment, and proactive problem-solving. He believes in building a strong rapport with his team and fostering open communication to address potential issues swiftly.

What sets Alistair apart is his commitment to continuous improvement and his eagerness to learn from industry experts. He actively seeks out training opportunities to stay abreast of the latest security protocols and technologies. His dedication to his craft makes him a valuable asset to any motorsport team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side with a slight wave.
physical.description: Alistair has a slim build and a focused gaze, giving him a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of double-checking every lock and seal, even after someone else has verified it.
Drinks chamomile tea before every major race to calm his nerves.
